starters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
starters.text:
Under the rules of this game, you may only include {Alabasta} type cards in your deck.
[When Attacking] Draw 2 cards. Then, at the end of your turn, trash cards from your hand until you have 7 cards in your hand.

starters.name: Mr. 0 (Crocodile)
starters.text:
[When Attacking] You may trash 1 card from your hand: Draw 1 card.
[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may K.O. 1 of your Characters with a type including "Baroque Works" and a base cost of 3 or more: Draw 1 card.
